payload.title: Stars on References and the 1-5 scale (adopt Papyrus PPY-49e9b5)
payload.description:
What: adopt the 1-5 judgement scale with Reference as a vote subject and migrate legacy up/down votes, in Shipped's configuration and tests. Shipped's own scripts read the new snapshot shape ({mean, n, hist, upShare}). Follows Papyrus PPY-5245ed and PPY-2cbf35.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Legacy votes read as stars
  Given a legacy up vote and a down vote
  When the migration has run
  Then they read as 5 and 1 and Shipped's pages show the new summary
